[Intro: fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft hum]

[Verse 1: quiet, gentle, close]
For a while there it was rough
I'll be honest, I'd had enough
Now there's coffee on at six
And a kid who's learning tricks
And my mother calls to laugh
And you sleep on my bad half

[Pre-Chorus: guitar strums harder, voice rising]

[Chorus: explosive, full rock band, roared]

[Verse 2: quiet again, a little shaken]
Got a roof and a garden bed
Got a calm inside my head
And I catch myself at night
Checking every lock and light
'Cause the best that I have known

[Pre-Chorus: guitar strums harder, voice rising]
And I know how these things go
I've seen a good thing overthrown

[Chorus: explosive, full rock band, roared]
So don't move a thing
Leave it, leave it like it is

Let me keep the lot

Oh, oh-oh
Please
Oh, oh-oh
Please

Leave it, leave it like it is
